content: Harmonized Driving//WarmUp cycles Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support harmonized Driving-/WarmUp cycles. The calculation of Driving-/WarmUp cycles is based on legal requirements. Rationale: OBD certification requires vehicle consistent calculations based on a harmonized Driving-/WarmUp cycle in the centralized OBD Master ECU.
